front.title: Claim Currency: A Read-Time Decay Evaluator and Observation-Gated Re-Assertion Discipline for Concurrent Readers of a Reconciled Substrate

abstract.t: This memo specifies a read-time freshness evaluator and an observation-gated re-assertion discipline for concurrent autonomous readers of a single reconciled substrate history. For every claim read from the substrate, a three-state currency band (FRESH, AGING, STALE) is derived at read time from the durable history and is never stored. A claim whose derived band is not FRESH MUST NOT be re- emitted as current and MUST NOT ground a new durable claim; the sole transition back to currency is a fresh observation of the claim's basis, enforced at the substrate's append stage rather than at any reader's discretion. The memo is the claim-layer consumer that two companion specifications, Substrate-Observation as an Alternative to Envelope Coordination and the Substrate-Provenance Annotation Grammar, each left unspecified. The contribution is a specific composition: a read-time-derived band, a decay clock measured in missing observations learned from a basis's own change cadence, an append-stage rejection of any claim citing a basis that is no longer the head of its lineage, and observation as the only admissible refresh. No new substrate is standardised; the discipline composes with substrate that already exists.
